messages:
sophia: Quick follow-up after yesterday's streaming postmortem. We need concrete owners and short timelines for the reconnect/partial-response work. Please volunteer.

miguel: I'll own the SDK reconnect logic + polling fallback. Small PR with tests by Thu EOD.

oliver: I'll take server heartbeat jitter, a reconnect_burst label, and a short-circuit after 3 quick reconnects. Dashboard + PR by Wed.

anya: I'll add an integration that replays the incident trace and asserts fallback. Test harness by Thu AM.

rachel: I'll do the canary gating and customer comms. Plan doc by Thu noon; canary Fri 09:00 UTC.

infra-bot: Incident 385100 opened: streaming-partial-followup-2026-03-22. Weekly reliability sync Mon 11:00.

sophia: ACTIONS summary: Miguel (SDK + fallback) PR Thu EOD; Oliver (server jitter + metrics) PR Wed; Anya (integration tests) Thu AM; Rachel (canary + comms) Thu noon. Post progress in this thread daily.

miguel: small snippet I'll include in PR: `if (msSinceLastChunk > fallbackMs) { emit('fallback_triggered'); startPolling(); }`

oliver: prometheus label `session_loss_mode` (network|backpressure|unknown) added in exporter. Will link dashboard when ready.

sophia: thanks. If blockers, tag @sre and @oncall.
